about_short_description.short_description: LemFi provides users with accounts in their country of residence and of origin for personal and business banking needs.

product.name: International Money Transfer
product.description: A digital service for sending money from supported countries to recipients in more than 30 countries through bank accounts, mobile money, and other supported payment methods.

product.name: LemFi Accounts and Wallet
product.description: Digital accounts and a multi-currency wallet for managing money in a country of residence and a country of origin, including personal and business financial needs.

product.name: LemFi Credit
product.description: A UK revolving credit line accessed through a virtual card, with purchases repaid automatically in 12 monthly instalments and intended to help eligible users build credit history.

product.name: LemFi eSIM
product.description: A travel eSIM service providing mobile data plans in more than 190 countries, purchased and managed through the LemFi app without replacing a physical SIM card.

product.name: Credit Monitor by LemFi
product.description: A free in-app service that provides eligible users with access to their UK Equifax credit score, credit report information, and guidance on factors affecting their credit profile.

product.name: Request Money
product.description: A payment-request service that lets users ask others to send money or share a payment link through the LemFi platform.
